-- Canonicalize only closed universe arithmetic produced by inference.
-- Any parameter or metavariable preserves the original whole level.
def psInferClosedLevelValue
    (level : PsLevel) : Option Nat :=
  match level with
  | PsLevel.zero =>
      Option.some 0
  | PsLevel.succ inner =>
      match psInferClosedLevelValue inner with
      | Option.none => Option.none
      | Option.some value => Option.some (Nat.succ value)
  | PsLevel.max left right =>
      match psInferClosedLevelValue left with
      | Option.none => Option.none
      | Option.some leftValue =>
          match psInferClosedLevelValue right with
          | Option.none => Option.none
          | Option.some rightValue =>
              if Nat.ble leftValue rightValue then
                Option.some rightValue
              else
                Option.some leftValue
  | PsLevel.imax left right =>
      match psInferClosedLevelValue left with
      | Option.none => Option.none
      | Option.some leftValue =>
          match psInferClosedLevelValue right with
          | Option.none => Option.none
          | Option.some rightValue =>
              if Nat.beq rightValue 0 then
                Option.some 0
              else if Nat.ble leftValue rightValue then
                Option.some rightValue
              else
                Option.some leftValue
  | PsLevel.param _ =>
      Option.none
  | PsLevel.mvar _ =>
      Option.none

def psInferLevelFromNat
    (value : Nat) : PsLevel :=
  match value with
  | Nat.zero => PsLevel.zero
  | Nat.succ remaining =>
      PsLevel.succ (psInferLevelFromNat remaining)

def psInferNormalizeClosedLevel
    (level : PsLevel) : PsLevel :=
  match psInferClosedLevelValue level with
  | Option.none => level

implementation.symbolicFallback: If any param or mvar occurs, evaluation returns none and the normalizer returns its original entire input level. In particular imax(param u,zero) and imax(mvar id,zero) are not simplified.
implementation.natOperations: Existing Nat.succ, Nat.beq and Nat.ble; max selects an existing operand value via Nat.ble.
implementation.producerBoundary: Only the freshly formed PsLevel.succ and PsLevel.imax inference results are normalized. Stored/substituted/decoded levels are not globally rewritten.

finiteDomainProof.statement: On finite proper acyclic levels, under the existing unbounded mathematical Nat semantics and an execution domain permitting the required finite allocation, normalization preserves universe denotation, produces the unique Peano form for closed levels, and preserves entire symbolic input levels unchanged.
finiteDomainProof.denotation: D(zero)=0; D(succ u)=D(u)+1; D(max u v)=max(D(u),D(v)); D(imax u v)=0 if D(v)=0, otherwise max(D(u),D(v)).
finiteDomainProof.evaluatorSoundness: Induction on the input constructor proves that E(l)=some n implies l has no symbolic leaf and n=D(l). Both operands are required before max/imax arithmetic is selected.
finiteDomainProof.evaluatorCompleteness: Induction on closed l proves E(l)=some D(l).
finiteDomainProof.symbolicCompleteness: Induction on l containing a param or mvar proves E(l)=none. Left-operand failure may short-circuit the remaining subtree, but the final result is still none and no partially normalized value escapes.
finiteDomainProof.reifier: Induction on n proves psInferLevelFromNat n is precisely succ^n zero and has denotation n.
finiteDomainProof.normalizer: The successful branch composes evaluator and reifier; the none branch returns the original function argument.
finiteDomainProof.idempotence: A Peano level evaluates to its numeral and reifies to the same constructor tree; symbolic input is returned unchanged on both passes.
finiteDomainProof.conversion: Unchanged owned-kernel MkMax/MkIMax and vendored Lean mk_max/mk_imax agree with these ground arithmetic identities. Therefore the freshly returned Sort has a universe convertible to the old raw arithmetic universe, without extending kernel theory or its checker.
finiteDomainProof.zeroRecognition: For closed l, the existing psLevelNormalizesToZero and psElabRecursionLevelIsProp predicates hold exactly when D(l)=0; canonicalization preserves that result. Symbolic levels are unchanged. This transport does not change proof/runtime binder classification by changing zero status.
finiteDomainProof.recursionTermination: Five evaluator self calls are on direct PsLevel child fields; one reifier self call is on the direct predecessor Nat field.

finiteBounds.evaluator: At most one visit per input tree occurrence, with possible early failure at a symbolic leaf.
finiteBounds.numeral: For closed l, D(l) is at most the number of succ constructors in l.
finiteBounds.reification: D(l)+1 level constructors, including zero; no expansion exponential in the input tree.
finiteBounds.allocation: Adds finite Option/Nat/intermediate-level work and a finite canonical level. No claim of allocation identity or constant-time arithmetic is made.
finiteBounds.stackAndTime: No wall-clock, machine-stack, memory-limit, or exception-equivalence guarantee is claimed beyond the stated finite proper allocation domain.
finiteBounds.inferenceFuel: The expression inference worker's fuel argument, recursive calls and failure branch are byte-for-byte unchanged. The level helpers do not decrement that fuel; they add explicit finite structural work with no separate cutoff.
